phase_name: Memory preflight and opt-in cgroup bounding

objectives.description: preflight mode (PSI + meminfo/swap), ratio-only thresholds, warn-vs-defer, opt-in systemd-run --user --scope cgroup wrapper with mandatory --quiet --collect, probe with real invocation, degradation notices

note: Verified manually: preflight silent+exit0 on unloaded machine; LAKE_BUILD_GUARD_PSI_PATH pointed at nonexistent file degrades to meminfo-only without crash; --memory-bound with systemd-run stripped from PATH emits stderr notice and completes an unbounded build; --memory-bound with systemd-run present propagates fake lake's exit 7 end to end; grep for GB/MB/G/M-suffixed numeric constants returns zero matches (MemoryHigh/MemoryMax expressed as systemd percentage strings, never bytes).
